limitations: This prepares content and metadata only. No website framework, domain, hosting provider, rendered page, deployment, backend, upload workflow, processing API, telemetry or runtime account is introduced or tested.

Relative repository links, reviewed external prerequisite/source links, conservative Markdown forms and metadata/asset invariants are checked locally. Actual website integration still requires manual content/render/link review in its supplied approved context.

Desktop ordinary-account Windows 11 PS5.1/PS7 runs and hosted Windows Server matrix results remain separate. Windows 10 remains untested and live UNC owner-excluded under D35; T067 owner approval remains bound to 5a32fc6533c6f9fae1d36c271b515d1d1dd4d8ad.

Version 1.0.0 remains unreleased and unsigned. Prior preparation ZIP hashes keep their old revision identities; final candidate and publication require an exact approved-revision rebuild/verification.
